Reflex Expertise.name: 反射豁免专精 Reflex Expertise
Reflex Expertise.description:
你已经练就了躲避危险的本领。你的反射豁免的熟练等级提升为专家。

You've developed a knack for dodging danger. Your proficiency rank for Reflex saves increases to expert.

Critical Eye.name: 致命之眼 Critical Eye
Critical Eye.description:
你对细节有着敏锐的洞察力，甚至能注意到几乎难以察觉的事物。你的察觉熟练等级提升至传奇。

You've got a critical eye for detail and notice the almost imperceptible. Your proficiency rank for Perception increases to legendary.

Exocortex.name: 外核心 Exocortex
Exocortex.description:
你构建了一套与自己大脑同步的、由自我驱动代码组成的精密程序，可用来远程操控一台由你自行设计的复杂装置。该程序及其与之连接的装置合称为外置皮层。

在1级时，你选择你的外置皮层。本书中介绍的外置皮层包括以下几种：无人机、地雷网络或可部署的炮塔。你可以以独特的方式调整你的外置皮层。

You've constructed a sophisticated program of self-motivated code synchronized with your brain, which you can use to remotely control a complex device of your own design. This program and its linked device are collectively called an exocortex.

At 1st level, you choose your exocortex. The exocortexes presented in this book include the following: a drone, a network of mines, or a deployable turret. You can Modify your exocortex in unique ways.

Prodigious Will.name: 惊人意志 Prodigious Will
Prodigious Will.description:
你的心智过于复杂而精密，无法被篡改。你的意志豁免的熟练等级提升为大师。当你进行意志豁免掷骰获得成功时，改为获得暴击成功。

Your mind is simply too complex and sophisticated to be tampered with. Your proficiency rank for Will saves increases to master. When you roll a success at a Will save, you get a critical success instead.

Mechanic Weapon Expertise.name: 技师武器专精 Mechanic Weapon Expertise
Mechanic Weapon Expertise.description:
你知道如何将构造武器的优势发挥到极致。你的简易武器、军用武器和徒手攻击的熟练等级提升为专家。你获得你具有专家熟练等级的所有武器的重击专精效果。若你拥有无人机外脑，你的无人机还会额外获得其具有专家熟练等级的所有武器的重击专精效果。

You know how to use constructed weapons to their best advantage. Your proficiency ranks for simple and martial weapons and unarmed attacks increase to expert. You gain access to the critical specialization effect of all weapons for which you have expert proficiency. If you have a drone exocortex, your drone additionally gains access to the critical specialization effects of all weapons for which it has expert proficiency.

Instant Mods.name: 即时模块 Instant Mods
Instant Mods.description:
你几乎不假思索就能随时定制物品。你可以以一个自由动作来调整，而不是以一个单动作来进行。

You can customize objects on the fly with barely a thought. You can Modify as a free action, rather than a single action.

Remote Mods.name: 远程模块 Remote Mods
Remote Mods.description:
你在外骨骼中枢设计上的突破使你能够远程添加模块。你可以调整你的外骨骼中枢的距离增加 30 英尺。如果你必须在外骨骼中枢的触及范围内才能调整它，则该距离改为 30 英尺。

A breakthrough in your exocortex's design enables you to add mods remotely. The range at which you can Modify your exocortex increases by 30 feet. If you must be within reach of your exocortex to Modify it, this increases the range to 30 feet.

Overclock Gear.name: 超频装备 Overclock Gear
Overclock Gear.description:
你可以用原始的魔法能量为你的科技装备供能，从而释放其真正潜力。你获得 @UUID[Compendium.starfinder-field-test-for-pf2e.sf2e-actions.Item.VMH34bRidGNubqYz]{超频装备} 动作。

You can unleash the true potential of your tech gear by powering it with raw magic energy. You gain the @UUID[Compendium.starfinder-field-test-for-pf2e.sf2e-actions.Item.VMH34bRidGNubqYz]{Overclock Gear} action.

Greater Weapon Specialization.name: 高等武器专精 Greater Weapon Specialization
Greater Weapon Specialization.description:
你在已达到专家熟练的武器和徒手攻击上，由武器专精获得的伤害加值提高至4；若为大师则为6；若为传奇则为8。

Your damage from weapon specialization increases to 4 with weapons and unarmed attacks in which you're an expert, 6 if you're a master, and 8 if you're legendary.

Turret.name: 炮塔 Turret
Turret.description:
你的外骨骼中枢连接着一座可部署的炮塔；不使用时，它可以轻松折叠并收纳在你的定制装备中。你只能部署一座炮塔，并且你的炮塔在收纳进定制装备时会保留其当前 HP。它占据一个 5 尺方格，并提供次等掩护。你可以在你的炮塔后方 @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.ust1jJSCZQUhBZIz]{采取掩护}。部署后，如果你位于炮塔 100 尺内，你可以远程发射这座炮塔，进行一次以炮塔位置为起点的远程打击。你的炮塔拥有自己的瞄准传感器，包括黑暗视觉，并不依赖你的视觉。你的炮塔使用你的攻击调整值，并与你共享多重攻击减值。

你的炮塔是一把具有 2 个升级槽的商用军用远程武器。你可以改进你的炮塔，使其成为战术型或更高等级，并遵循改进武器的通常规则（《Starfinder Playtest Rulebook》第 236 页）。你的炮塔升级槽位于你的定制装备上，而非炮塔本体，并会自动远程内嵌到你所部署的任何炮塔中。你的炮塔消耗值为 0，且不需要弹药。它的等级等于你的等级，它的 AC 等于你的技师职业 DC，并且其硬度等于你等级的一半（向上取整）。它在反射和强韧豁免上具有受训熟练等级，并使用你的智力调整值来计算这些加值。它拥有 6 点生命值，外加你每有 1 个等级便获得等于 2 + 你的智力调整值的生命值。它的损坏阈值等于其总生命值的一半（向下取整）。在你的每日准备期间，你会自动修理你的炮塔，使其恢复至最大生命值。如果你的炮塔被摧毁，那么你下次部署炮塔时，部署出的将是一座已修复且具有最大生命值的炮塔。你同一时间只能部署一座炮塔。

在 5 级时，你的炮塔硬度提升至 10。在 10 级时，它提升至 15，且其反射和强韧豁免的熟练等级提升为专家。在 15 级时，其硬度提升至 20，且其反射和强韧豁免的熟练等级提升为大师。

为你的炮塔从以下构型中选择一种，这将决定它的伤害类型和射程增量。你可以花费 10 分钟，使用你的定制装备改装炮塔，以改变其所选构型。

  • 链炮：@Damage[1d8[piercing]] 伤害，射程增量 90 尺，非电子特征，投射武器组
  • 解离器：@Damage[1d8[acid]] 伤害，射程增量 60 尺，科技特征，腐蚀武器组
  • 激光束：@Damage[1d8[fire]] 伤害，射程增量 60 尺，科技特征，激光武器组
  • 雷霆震响器：@Damage[1d8[sonic]] 伤害，射程增量 60 尺，科技特征，音波武器组
  • 电压投射器：@Damage[1d8[electricity]] 伤害，射程增量 60 尺，科技特征，电击武器组
  • 零度发射器：@Damage[1d8[cold]] 伤害，射程增量 60 尺，科技特征，低温武器组

Your exocortex connects to a deployable turret that is easily collapsed and stored in your custom rig when not in use. You can only deploy one turret, and your turret retains its current HP when stored in your custom rig. It occupies a 5-foot square and provides lesser cover. You can @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.ust1jJSCZQUhBZIz]{Take Cover} behind your turret. Once deployed, you can fire this turret remotely if you are within 100 feet of the turret, as a ranged Strike originating from the turret's location. Your turret has its own targeting sensors, including darkvision, and doesn't rely on your vision. Your turret uses your attack modifier and shares your multiple attack penalty.

Your turret is a commercial martial ranged weapon with 2 upgrade slots. You can improve your turret, making it tactical or better, following the typical rules for improving weapons (Starfinder Playtest Rulebook 236). Your turret's upgrade slots are located on your custom rig, rather than the turret itself, and are automatically remotely installed in any turret you Deploy. Your turret has an expend of 0 and does not require ammo. Its level is equal to your level, its AC is equal to your mechanic class DC, and it has Hardness equal to half your level (rounded up). It has trained proficiency in Reflex and Fortitude saves, using your Intelligence modifier to calculate these bonuses. It has 6 Hit Points, plus a number of Hit Points equal to 2 plus your Intelligence modifier for each level you have. Its Broken Threshold is equal to half its total Hit Points (rounded down). During your daily preparations, you automatically repair your turret, restoring it to maximum Hit Points. If your turret is destroyed, the next time you Deploy Turret, you deploy a repaired turret with maximum Hit Points. You can only have one turret deployed at a time.

At 5th level, your turret's Hardness increases to 10. At 10th level, it increases to 15 and its proficiency rank in Reflex and Fortitude saves increases to expert. At 15th level, its Hardness increases to 20, and its proficiency rank in Reflex and Fortitude saves increases to master.

Select one of the following arrays for your turret, which determines its damage type and range increment. You can spend 10 minutes modifying your turret using your custom rig to change its selected array.

  • Chaingun: @Damage[1d8[piercing]] damage, range increment 90 feet, analog trait, projectile weapon group
  • Disintegrator: @Damage[1d8[acid]] damage, range increment 60 feet, tech trait, corrosive weapon group
  • Laser Beam: @Damage[1d8[fire]] damage, range increment 60 feet, tech trait, laser weapon group
  • Thunderclap: @Damage[1d8[sonic]] damage, range increment 60 feet, tech trait, sonic weapon group
  • Volt Thrower: @Damage[1d8[electricity]] damage, range increment 60 feet, tech trait, shock weapon group
  • Zero Emitter: @Damage[1d8[cold]] damage, range increment 60 feet, tech trait, cryo weapon group

DPS++.name: DPS++
DPS++.description:
DPS++ 是首屈一指的武器编程语言，整合了来自银河各地编程语言中的战术指令、快捷方式与创新设计，以造成最大程度的破坏。这项令人惊叹的计算机科学壮举，正是武器升级能够实现通用兼容性的原因。

超频增幅（武器）你将目标因掩护获得的 AC 处境加值降低，降低值等于你为使装备超频而施放的法术环级的一半（至少为 1）。你将任何因射程导致的减值减少 1。你获得等同于你为使装备超频而施放的法术环级的武器伤害处境加值。若该法术造成了伤害，则这部分加值伤害的类型与该法术造成的伤害类型相同，而非武器的通常伤害类型（如果该法术造成多种类型的伤害，则从这些选项中选择一种伤害类型）。

越狱塑法 当你使用“法术越狱”将“信号增幅”塑法应用于一个造成伤害的法术时，你对该法术的一个目标获得等同于你武器基础武器骰的伤害物品加值。不要将任何其他调整值应用于该伤害，包括专长、属性调整值、武器特性和武器升级。

DPS++ is the premier programming language for weapons, incorporating tactical commands, shortcuts, and innovations from programming languages found across the galaxy to cause maximum destruction. This incredible feat of computer science is responsible for the universal compatibility of weapon upgrades.

Overclock Boost (weapon) You reduce the circumstance bonus to AC your targets have from cover by an amount equal to half the rank of the spell you cast to overclock your gear (minimum 1). Reduce any penalties due to range by 1. You gain a circumstance bonus to weapon damage equal to the rank of the spell you cast to overclock your gear. If the spell dealt damage, this bonus damage is of the same type of damage the spell dealt, rather than the weapon's normal damage (if the spell dealt multiple types of damage, select one damage type from among those options).

Jailbreak Spellshape When you Jailbreak Spell to apply the Signal Boost spellshape to a spell that deals damage, you gain an item bonus to damage equal to the base weapon die of your weapon to one target of the spell. Do not apply any other modifiers to the damage, including feats, attribute modifiers, weapon traits, and weapon upgrades.

Mechanic's Ingenuity.name: 技师的巧思 Mechanic's Ingenuity
Mechanic's Ingenuity.description:
在 3级、7级和15级时，你获得一次额外的技能提升，但只能将其应用于计算机或制作。你还会在这些等级获得一个额外的技能专长。该专长必须用于计算机或制作。

At 3rd, 7th, and 15th level, you gain an additional skill increase you can apply only to Computers or Crafting. You also gain an additional skill feat at these levels. This feat must be for Computers or Crafting.

Enduring Mods.name: 耐久模块 Enduring Mods
Enduring Mods.description:
你的定制经久耐用。每天，在你进行每日准备时，从你已知的模组中选择一个应用到一件物品上。这个模组不计入你的上限。所选模组持续24小时或直到被解除。

Your customizations are built to last. Each day, pick one mod you know to apply to an item during your daily preparations. This mod doesn't count against your limit. The selected mod lasts for 24 hours or until dismissed.

Mechanical Expertise.name: 机械专长 Mechanical Expertise
Mechanical Expertise.description:
你作为技师的能力有所提升。你的技师职业DC的熟练等级提升为专家。

Your skill as a mechanic has improved. Your proficiency rank for your mechanic class DC increases to expert.

Modify.name: 调整 Modify
Modify.description:
你的自定义装备让你能够即时定制你持有的物品，在有限时间内提升其效能或多功能性。你可以使用 @UUID[Compendium.starfinder-field-test-for-pf2e.sf2e-actions.Item.neyS5TJB8fTmQEKu]{调整} 动作来进行此类调整。

Your custom rig allows you to customize items in your possession on the fly, increasing their effectiveness or versatility for a limited time. You can make such adjustments using the @UUID[Compendium.starfinder-field-test-for-pf2e.sf2e-actions.Item.neyS5TJB8fTmQEKu]{Modify} action.

Mine.name: 采矿 Mine
Mine.description:
你的外骨骼中枢管理着一组地雷。你可以用“部署地雷”动作部署这些地雷，并用“引爆地雷”动作或反应来激活它们。你的地雷受到防护，不会因受到伤害而引爆。停用你地雷的 DC 等于你的职业 DC。你可以用一个单一动作收回一个与你相邻、已部署且未引爆的地雷，并将其与你其他已准备好的地雷一同存放在你的定制装备中。

在你进行每日准备时，你可以制造最多等于 2 + 你的智力调整值数量的地雷，这也是你的地雷数量上限。如果你的地雷数量低于上限，你可以使用你的定制装备制作新的地雷。你每在探索模式中花费 10 分钟，就恢复 2 枚地雷；这不会妨碍你参与其他探索活动。你可以将所有地雷存放在你的定制装备中，且不会增加其负载。

虽然你的地雷是实体物体，但如果在你下次进行每日准备之前未被使用，它们就会被摧毁。它们无法以任何方式被复制或保存。

Your exocortex manages a network of mines. You can deploy these mines with the Deploy Mine action and activate them with the Detonate Mine action or reaction. Your mines are shielded and can't detonate from taking damage. The DC to Disable your mines is equal to your class DC. You can collect an adjacent, deployed, and undetonated mine as a single action, storing it alongside your other prepared mines in your custom rig.

During your daily preparations, you can create a number of mines up to 2 + your Intelligence modifier, which is also your maximum number of mines. If you're below your maximum number, you can craft new mines using your custom rig. For every 10 minutes you spend in exploration mode, you regain 2 mines; this doesn't prevent you from participating in other exploration activities. You can store all your mines in your custom rig, with no increase to its Bulk.

Though your mines are physical objects, they are destroyed if not used by the next time you make your daily preparations. They can't be duplicated or preserved in any way.

Mechanical Mastery.name: 机械精通 Mechanical Mastery
Mechanical Mastery.description:
你作为技师的本领在整个银河系都广为人知。你的技师职业 DC 的熟练等级提升为大师。

Your skill as a mechanic is well known throughout the galaxy. Your proficiency rank for your mechanic class DC increases to master.

Will Expertise.name: 意志专精 Will Expertise
Will Expertise.description:
你的心灵防御变得更强。你的意志豁免熟练等级提升为专家。

Your mental defenses grow stronger. Your proficiency rank for Will saves increases to expert.

Technomancer Spellcasting.name: 科技法师施法 Technomancer Spellcasting
Technomancer Spellcasting.description:
你是一名施法者，并且可以使用“施放法术”活动施放奥术传统的法术。作为科技法师，当你施放法术时，你会使用特定的奥术手势、快速输入，或口头通行短语来“黑入”魔法，常常会在你用来引导魔法力量的科技装备周围显现出奥术符文。

在1级时，你每天早晨可以从你的法术数据库中的法术里准备至多两个1环法术和五个戏法。已准备的法术会一直可供你使用，直到你施放它们，或直到你再次准备法术。你能够准备的法术数量称为你的法术位。

随着你作为科技法师等级提升，你每天能准备的法术数量会增加，你能够施放的最高法术环阶也会提高，如“科技法师每日法术”表所示。

你的某些法术需要你进行一次法术攻击，以确定其效果有多好；或者要求你的敌人对抗你的法术DC进行掷骰（通常是尝试一次豁免检定）。由于你的关键属性是智力，你的法术攻击调整值和法术DC都使用你的智力调整值。

法术升阶

当你获得2环及更高环阶的法术位时，你可以用较低环阶法术的更强版本来填充这些法术位。这会提高该法术的环阶，使其升阶以匹配该法术位。许多法术在升阶到特定环阶时会获得特定强化。

戏法

你的部分法术是戏法。戏法是一种特殊类型的法术，不使用法术位。你可以随意施放戏法，每天施放任意次数。戏法总会自动升阶至你等级的一半并向上取整——这通常等于你所拥有的最高科技法师法术位环阶。例如，作为1级科技法师，你的戏法是1环法术；而作为5级科技法师，你的戏法则是3环法术。

法术数据库

你的法术数据库是一个科技物体，其中包含一个个性化的数字数据库，记录着你所知晓且会施放的每一个法术。你起始时就拥有一个法术数据库，这是你免费获得的，并且你必须每天研读它来准备法术。你的法术数据库的形式和名称由你决定。它可能是一个通讯单元、数据板、集成在你义眼中的镜片，等等。如果它遭到损坏、被摧毁或被偷走，它就会失去魔法，而你可以用一个10分钟活动将你的法术数据库下载到另一个科技装置上。该法术数据库包含你选择的10个奥术戏法和5个1环奥术法术。你从奥术法术列表上的常见法术中选择这些法术，或从你获得施法权限的其他奥术法术中选择。你还会从你的编程语言中额外加入1个1环法术。

每当你获得一个等级时，你都会向法术数据库中加入两个奥术法术，其环阶可以是你拥有法术位的任意环阶；这些法术从你传统中的常见法术，或其他你通过“学习法术”获得接触权限并学会的法术中选择。当你获得新环阶的法术位时，你还会从你的编程语言中额外向法术数据库加入一个法术。

魔法黑客技

魔法黑客技是一种专注法术。施放一个专注法术需要消耗1点专注点，而你起始拥有一个包含1点专注点的专注池。你会在每日准备期间补满你的专注池，并且你可以通过花费10分钟使用“重新专注”活动滚动浏览你的法术数据库或进行奥术研究来恢复1点专注点。专注法术会像戏法一样，自动升阶至你等级的一半并向上取整。专注法术不需要法术位，而且你不能使用法术位来施放它们。某些专长会给予你更多专注法术。你的专注池所能容纳的最大专注点数等于你拥有的专注法术数量，但永远不能超过3点。

在1级时，你会学会一个初始魔法黑客技，它是你的编程语言所独有的。你可以通过“高级魔法黑客技”专长学会一个先进魔法黑客技，并通过“强效魔法黑客技”专长学会一个强效魔法黑客技。

You are a spellcaster, and you can cast spells of the arcane tradition using the Cast a Spell activity. As a technomancer, when you cast spells, you use specific arcane gestures, rapid typing, or verbal passphrases to hack magic, often manifesting arcane runes around the tech gear you use to channel your magic power.

At 1st level, you can prepare up to two 1st-rank spells and five cantrips each morning from the spells in your spell database. Prepared spells remain available to you until you cast them or until you prepare your spells again. The number of spells you can prepare is called your spell slots.

As you increase in level as a technomancer, the number of spells you can prepare each day increases, as does the highest rank of spell you can cast, as shown in the Technomancer Spells per Day table.

Some of your spells require you to attempt a spell attack to see how effective they are, or have your enemies roll against your spell DC (typically by attempting a saving throw). Since your key attribute is Intelligence, your spell attack modifier and spell DC use your Intelligence modifier.

Heightening Spells

When you get spell slots of 2nd rank and higher, you can fill those slots with stronger versions of lower-rank spells. This increases the spell's rank, heightening it to match the spell slot. Many spells have specific improvements when they are heightened to certain ranks.

Cantrips

Some of your spells are cantrips. A cantrip is a special type of spell that doesn't use spell slots. You can cast a cantrip at will, any number of times per day. A cantrip is always automatically heightened to half your level rounded up—this is usually equal to the highest rank of technomancer spell slot you have. For example, as a 1st-level technomancer, your cantrips are 1st-rank spells, and as a 5th-level technomancer, your cantrips are 3rd-rank spells.

Spell Database

Your spell database is a technological object that contains a personalized digital database of every spell you know how to cast. You start with a spell database, which you receive for free and must study each day to prepare your spells. Your spell database's form and name are up to you. It might be a comm unit, datapad, a lens integrated into your prosthetic eye, and so on. If it's ever damaged, destroyed, or stolen, it loses its magic, and you can download your spell database onto another technological device as a 10-minute activity. The spell database contains your choice of 10 arcane cantrips and five 1st-rank arcane spells. You choose these from the common spells on the arcane spell list or from other arcane spells you gain access to. You also add one 1st-rank spell from your programming language.

Each time you gain a level, you add two arcane spells to your spell database, of any spell rank for which you have spell slots, chosen from common spells of your tradition or others you gain access and learn via Learn a Spell. When you gain spell slots of a new rank, you also add an additional spell from your programming language to your spell database.

Magic Hacks

Magic hacks are a type of focus spell. It costs 1 Focus Point to cast a focus spell, and you start with a focus pool of 1 Focus Point. You refill your focus pool during your daily preparations, and you can regain 1 Focus Point by spending 10 minutes using the Refocus activity to scroll through your spell database or conduct arcane research. Focus spells are automatically heightened to half your level rounded up, much like cantrips. Focus spells don't require spell slots, and you can't cast them using spell slots. Certain feats give you more focus spells. The maximum Focus Points your focus pool can hold is equal to the number of focus spells you have, but it can never be more than 3 points.

At 1st level, you learn an initial magic hack, which is unique to your programming language. You can learn an advanced magic hack with the Advanced Magic Hack feat and a greater magic hack with the Greater Magic Hack feat.

Custom Rig.name: 自定义装备 rig Custom Rig
Custom Rig.description:
你起始时拥有一套名为“定制装备”的专用工具包。你的定制装备重量为1 Bulk，并且同时视为一套商业级维修工具包，以及以下工具包中你选择的任意一种：商业级骇入工具包、商业级渗透工具包，或商业级制造工具包。若你正穿戴着它，你可以用一只手使用你的定制装备；若你正手持它，则需要用两只手使用。

每当你购买上述工具包之一，或上述工具包之一的更高等级版本时，你都可以花费10分钟将该工具包整合进你的定制装备中。若你这么做，你的定制装备将获得该工具包的属性。这不会增加你的定制装备的 Bulk。你的定制装备以及任何整合进去的工具包都不能被出售，也不能由其他生物使用。

You begin with a specialized toolkit called a custom rig. Your custom rig weighs 1 Bulk and counts as both a commercial repair toolkit plus any one of the following toolkits of your choice: a commercial hacking toolkit, a commercial infiltrator's toolkit, or a commercial maker's toolkit. You can use your custom rig with one hand if you're wearing it or two hands if you're holding it.

Whenever you purchase one of the listed toolkits, or a higher-grade version of one of the listed toolkits, you can spend 10 minutes integrating that toolkit into your custom rig. If you do, your custom rig gains the properties of the toolkit. This does not increase the Bulk of your custom rig. Your custom rig and any integrated toolkits can't be sold or used by another creature.

Manifold Mods.name: 流形模块 Manifold Mods
Manifold Mods.description:
你已经学会更聪明地工作，而不是更卖力地工作，并且你可以一次安装多个模块。每当你调整一件物品时，你可以选择两个你已知的模块，而不是一个。

You've learned to work smarter, not harder, and you can install multiple mods at once. Whenever you Modify an item, you can select two mods you know instead of one.

Mobile Exocortex.name: 移动型外骨骼核心 Mobile Exocortex
Mobile Exocortex.description:
你升级了自己的外骨骼中枢，使与其连接的装置更具机动性或更加灵活。此效果取决于你所选择的外骨骼中枢。如果你拥有无人机外骨骼中枢，你获得“同步步调”动作。如果你拥有地雷或炮塔外骨骼中枢，你获得“重新部署外骨骼中枢”动作。

You've upgraded your exocortex, making devices connected to it more mobile or nimble. This effect depends on the exocortex you selected. If you have a drone exocortex, you gain the Synchronized Step action. If you have a mine or turret exocortex, you gain the Reposition Exocortex action.

Programming Languages.name: 编程语言 Programming Languages
Programming Languages.description:
在1级时，你选择一种编程语言，你借此理解魔法，并用它来储存、操控和破解你的法术。

法术缓存库：你的编程语言会赋予你额外已知法术；这些加值法术就是你的法术缓存库。你会自动将你的编程语言的法术缓存库中列出的1环法术加入你的法术数据库和法术缓存库。每当你获得施放新环阶科技法师法术的能力时，将你的编程语言的法术缓存库中对应的法术加入你的法术数据库和法术缓存库。你可以使用下载法术动作，以法术缓存库中的一个法术替换一个已准备法术。

魔法破解：你的编程语言会赋予你一种称为魔法破解的专注法术。

法术塑形：你的编程语言会赋予你操控魔法的创新方式。你在1级时获得所列出的法术塑形专长。

超频增益：每种编程语言都与一种特定类型的物品相关联，该类型会在超频增益条目中以括号注明。你只能对与你的编程语言物品类型相符的物品使用“装备超频”。当你持有、穿戴或持用一个已超频的物品，或者拥有一个已超频的仆从时，你获得超频增益的效果。

越狱法术塑形：在3级时，当你进行“法术越狱”并选择应用你的编程语言偏好的法术塑形时，除其通常的越狱加值外，你还会获得越狱法术塑形条目中列出的额外收益。

At 1st level, you select a programming language, which you use to understand magic and to store, manipulate, and hack your spells.

Spell Cache: Your programming language grants you additional spells known; these bonus spells are your spell cache. You automatically add the 1st-rank spell listed in your programming language's spell cache to your spell database and your spell cache. As soon as you gain the ability to cast technomancer spells of a new rank, add the associated spell from your programming language's spell cache to your spell database and spell cache. You can use the Download Spell action to replace a prepared spell with a spell in your spell cache.

Magic Hacks: Your programming language grants you a type of focus spell called a magic hack.

Spellshapes: Your programming language grants you innovative ways to manipulate magic. You gain the listed spellshape feat at 1st level.

Overclock Boost: Each programming language is associated with a specific type of item, noted in parentheses in the overclock boost entry. You can only Overclock Gear on items that match your programming language's item type. When you are holding, wearing, or wielding an overclocked item, or have an overclocked minion, you gain the benefits of the overclock boost.

Jailbreak Spellshape: At 3rd level, when you Jailbreak Spell and choose to apply your programming language's preferred spellshape, you gain the additional benefit listed in the jailbreak spellshape entry in addition to its normal jailbreak bonus.

Drone.name: 无人机 Drone
Drone.description:
你的外骨骼心智连接到一个名为无人机的基础机器人伙伴，它会陪伴你进行冒险，并尽其所能遵循你的神经指令。更多信息见“机器人伙伴”。无人机类型详见第16页。除了所有机器人伙伴都会获得的定制外，你的无人机初始还带有一个内置武器挂载。你可以在最远150英尺的距离内用意念控制你的无人机；只有你能够操作、控制和修理你的无人机。如果你的无人机超出你的控制范围，它就无法执行任何动作。在你每日准备期间，你会自动修理你的无人机，将其恢复至最大生命值，即使它已被摧毁也是如此。你还可以通过选取专长来进一步定制并提升你的无人机。

你可以花费额外时间来指挥你的无人机，以执行更复杂的行动计划。指挥你的无人机时，你可以花费2个动作而非1个来进行Command；随后你的无人机可以额外使用1个动作（通常为3个动作，而非2个）。

当你处于可触及范围内时，你可以调整你的无人机及其持用的任何武器。为“调整”的用途，无人机视为护甲。你获得以下新模块。

  • 孤注一掷修理（无人机外骨骼心智）：你的无人机获得等同于你等级加你的智力调整值的临时生命值。

  • 杀戮机器人（无人机外骨骼心智）：你的无人机的伤害掷骰获得+2状态加值。如果你的无人机的打击造成超过一个武器伤害骰，则该状态加值变为每个武器伤害骰2点，最多在四个武器伤害骰时达到+8。

Your exocortex connects to a basic robot companion called a drone, which accompanies you on your adventures and follows your neural commands to the best of its abilities. See Robot Companions for more information. Drone types are detailed on page 16. In addition to the customization all robot companions receive, your drone begins with one integrated weapon mount. You control your drone with your thoughts at a range of up to 150 feet; only you can operate, control, and repair your drone. If your drone is ever beyond your range of control, it can't perform any actions. During your daily preparations, you automatically repair your drone, restoring it to maximum Hit Points, even if it's been destroyed. You can further customize and advance your drone by taking feats.

You can spend additional time directing your drone for a more complex plan of action. You can spend 2 actions to Command instead of 1 when commanding your drone; your drone can then use an additional action (normally 3 actions, rather than 2).

You can Modify your drone and any weapons it wields when you are within reach. The drone counts as armor for the purposes of Modify. You gain the following new mods.

  • Desperate Repair (drone exocortex): Your drone gains temporary Hit Points equal to your level plus your Intelligence modifier.

  • Killbot (drone exocortex): Your drone gains a +2 status bonus to damage rolls. If your drone's Strikes deal more than one weapon damage die, the status bonus increases to 2 per weapon damage die, to a maximum of +8 with four weapon damage dice.

Legendary Spellcaster.name: 传奇施法者 Legendary Spellcaster
Legendary Spellcaster.description:
你是技艺精湛的施法者，兼通奥术理论与实用施法技艺。你的法术攻击修正值和法术DC的熟练等级提升至传奇。

You are a consummate spellcaster, blending both arcane theory and practical spellcraft. Your proficiency ranks for spell attack modifier and spell DC increase to legendary.

Jailbreak Spell.name: 越狱法术 Jailbreak Spell
Jailbreak Spell.description:
你获得@UUID[Compendium.starfinder-field-test-for-pf2e.sf2e-actions.Item.EE07CnQmn8Xg4gkd]{越狱法术}动作。

You gain the @UUID[Compendium.starfinder-field-test-for-pf2e.sf2e-actions.Item.EE07CnQmn8Xg4gkd]{Jailbreak Spell} action.

Medium Armor Expertise.name: 中型护甲专长 Medium Armor Expertise
Medium Armor Expertise.description:
你已学会更好地保护自己，抵御攻击。你在轻甲、中甲和无甲防御上的熟练等级提升至专家。

You've learned to defend yourself better against attacks. Your proficiency ranks for light armor, medium armor, and unarmored defense increase to expert.

Defensive Measures.name: 防御措施 Defensive Measures
Defensive Measures.description:
你体内残留的魔法和所受的训练帮助你避开攻击。你在无甲防御上的熟练等级提升为专家。

The residual magic in your body and your training helps you avoid attacks. Your proficiency rank in unarmored defense increases to expert.

Damage Customizations.name: 伤害定制 Damage Customizations
Damage Customizations.description:
你已经开发出能够暂时将一种能量嬗变为另一种类型的工具，并解决了为你的物理攻击增加多样性所需的复杂计算。将以下模块加入你可通过“调整”选择的选项列表中。

  • 能量多样性（手雷或造成能量伤害的武器）：你为该物品添加一个定制能量转换器。该物品造成以下伤害类型之一，而非其通常的伤害类型：强酸、寒冷、电击、火焰、音波。
  • 物理多样性（手雷或造成物理伤害的武器）：你调整该物品的结构，改变其破坏潜力。该物品造成以下伤害类型之一，而非其通常的伤害类型：钝击、穿刺、挥砍。

You've developed the tools to temporarily transmute energy from one type to another, and you've solved complex calculations required to add versatility to your physical attacks. Add the following mods to the list of options you can select with Modify.

  • Energy Versatility (grenade or weapon that deals energy damage): You add a custom energy converter to the item. The item deals one of the following damage types, rather than its typical damage type: acid, cold, electricity, fire, sonic.
  • Physical Versatility (grenade or weapon that deals physical damage): You modify the item's structure, changing its destructive potential. The item deals one of the following damage types, rather than its typical damage type: bludgeoning, piercing, slashing.

Perception Mastery.name: 感知精通 Perception Mastery
Perception Mastery.description:
你对细节的关注使你能够对周围的威胁保持警觉。你的察觉熟练等级提升为大师。

Your attention to detail enables you to remain alert to threats around you. Your proficiency rank for Perception increases to master.

Weapon Specialization.name: 武器专精 Weapon Specialization
Weapon Specialization.description:
你已学会如何用自己最擅长的武器造成更严重的伤害。对于你熟练等级达到专家的武器和徒手攻击，你造成的伤害额外增加 2 点。若你的熟练等级为大师，则该伤害增至 3 点；若为传奇，则增至 4 点。

You've learned how to inflict greater injuries with the weapons you know best. You deal 2 additional damage with weapons and unarmed attacks in which you are an expert. This damage increases to 3 damage if you're a master, and 4 damage if you're legendary.

Mechanic Weapon Mastery.name: 技师武器专精 Mechanic Weapon Mastery
Mechanic Weapon Mastery.description:
你完全理解武器的各种细微之处。你在简易武器、军用武器和徒手攻击上的熟练等级提升至大师。

You fully understand the intricacies of weapons. Your proficiency rank for simple and martial weapons and unarmed attacks increases to master.

Spell Cache.name: 法术缓存库 Spell Cache
Spell Cache.description:
你为自己偏好的法术创造了一套魔法速记，使它们更容易施放。你一旦能够施放相应环阶的法术，就会自动将你的编程语言中的法术加入你的缓存库。你的法术数据库中的已缓存法术可以在你每日准备时照常准备，或者你也可以 Downloaded these Spells 来覆写并替换你已经准备好的其他法术，使其能够使用那个法术位施放。你获得 @UUID[Compendium.starfinder-field-test-for-pf2e.sf2e-actions.Item.oHVC3U1F4MvRkrKk]{下载法术} 动作。

You've created a magical shorthand for your favored spells that makes them easier to cast. You automatically add spells to your cache from your programming language as soon as you can cast spells of the appropriate rank. Cached spells in your spell database can be prepared normally during your daily preparations or you can Downloaded these Spells to overwrite and replace other spells you've already prepared so they can be cast using that spell slot. You gain the @UUID[Compendium.starfinder-field-test-for-pf2e.sf2e-actions.Item.oHVC3U1F4MvRkrKk]{Download Spell} action.

Viper.name: 毒蛇 Viper
Viper.description:
这种编程语言最初由为蛇徽财团工作的工程师开发，目的是将混合物品，尤其是法术芯片和法术宝石的制造标准化。虽然这套代码最初是为了帮助将多语言混合魔法物品安装进仿制古董中，以便销往整个银河，但由于其强调代码可读性和多语言兼容性，它后来被实现为一种高级通用编程语言。

越狱塑法 当你使用“法术回路”法术塑形从法术宝石中施放法术时，你可以以一个自由动作抽出该混合物品，并在你的下个回合结束前将其视为一个等级等于或低于该法术宝石等级的电磁手雷。例如，4环法术宝石会被视为先进手雷，而6环法术宝石会被视为卓越电磁手雷。如果该法术造成了伤害，则该电磁手雷的伤害改为使用该法术所造成的一种伤害类型，而非电击伤害。

This programming language was originally developed by engineers working for the Aspis Consortium to standardize the manufacturing of hybrid items, especially spell chips and spell gems. While this code was made to help install multilingual hybrid magic items into replica antiques to sell across the galaxy, it's since been implemented as a high-level, general purpose programming language thanks to its emphasis on code readability and multilinguistic compatibility.

Overclock Boost (spell gem or spell chip) You can hack other magic traditions. When you Overclock a spell gem or spell chip with spells from another tradition, you can Cast a Spell using that item as a spell of the arcane tradition using your spell DC and attack rolls as normal.

Jailbreak Spellshape When you Jailbreak Spell using the Spell Circuit spellshape to Cast a Spell from a spell gem, you can draw the hybrid item as a free action and treat it as an electromag grenade with a level equal to or less than the level of the spell gem until the end of your next turn. For example, a 4th-rank spell gem is treated as an advanced grenade and a 6th-rank spell gem is treated as a superior electromag grenade. If the spell dealt damage, the damage of the electromag grenade uses one type of damage the spell dealt instead of electricity.
